resolution.title: Add test for watchdog punching
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Add test case for checking watchdog punching arming watchdog without calling `arm()` on platforms that have watchdog armed permanently.

Summary:
Resolves https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/24185

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?

Add test case for checking watchdog is being armed periodically without having to call `arm` explicitly manually.

#### How did you do it?

- Add a parameter to the test config to indicate if platform has watchdog punching enabled all the time
- Check that watchdog is armed
- Sleep for `remaining_time` as indicated by watchdog API
- Check that watchdog is still armed

#### How did you verify/test it?

Run all test cases with the parameter `has_watchdog_punching` set to true. When the parameter is missing or is set to false, ensure the `test_punching_arm ` test is skipped with all other test cases passing.
